items.title: Matthew Maxey Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: Well, lots of times they call a man who's been here a long time, they call him a Reptimer.

ctx.x: Reptimers? Say that again for a minute. I want to get the pronunciation.
Well, lots of times they call a man who's been here a long time, they call him a Reptimer.
Is that like R-A-P, like you rap on a guitar?
